'''Crost Lib'eyay''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] ex-[[Spy/Legends|spy]] who served as the [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of [[StarForge Station]]&mdash;a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[StarForge Nebula/Legends|StarForge Nebula]]&mdash;during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
